nexscope/billing.instruction: Check current pricing before execution. Do not automatically retry a paid call.

commission_rate.description: Affiliate product commission rate, such as `0.15`

is_affiliate.description: Whether it is an alliance product: `PUBLIC_PLAN` (yes) or `NON_AFFILIATE` (no)

is_tts_product.description: Whether the product is fully managed: `1` (fully managed) or `0` (not fully managed)

livestream_id.description: Returns the products associated with the specified live broadcast

pageSize.description: Number of items per page, range 5-100

revenue_range.description: Transaction amount / GMV range, left closed and right open

sortField.description: Sorting specification object, the available fields are subject to those actually accepted by the gateway.

unit_price_range.description: Product price range, left closed and right open

video_id.description: Returns the products associated with the specified video
